headline: 今日无新片，影剧热度榜出炉
headlineEn: No New Releases Today; Film & TV Heat Ranked
summary: 今日影市零新片上映，本周仅1部新片；电影热度由《生化危机：爆发夜》领跑，剧集方面《镀金时代》与《末路兼职》表现最热。
summaryEn: No new films opened today with only one new movie this week; Resident Evil: Outbreak Night leads movie heat, while The Gilded Age and Dead-End Side Job top TV buzz.

industryHighlights.text: 今日无新电影上映，本周仅1部新片入市。
industryHighlights.en: No new movies released today; only one new film arrives this week.

industryHighlights.text: 《生化危机：爆发夜》领跑今日电影热度。
industryHighlights.en: Resident Evil: Outbreak Night leads today's movie buzz.

industryHighlights.text: 《镀金时代》与《末路兼职》占据剧集热度前列。
industryHighlights.en: The Gilded Age and Dead-End Side Job top TV heat.

industryHighlights.text: 《嗜血法医：杀魔复生》与Lupin持续在榜，暂无重磅待映。
industryHighlights.en: Dexter: Resurrection and Lupin remain on the chart; no notable upcoming titles.
